text: Correction: this call is still a forecast on Grants.gov, not a published call. 7 Dec 2026 is only the estimated deadline: the official call, with its final dates and requirements, has not been released yet. Foreign organisations are not eligible. We will update our open calls page (link in bio) when the call is published.
